public.text: Several glossary terms are under review and 'Health Information Exchange' is still to be included. Since the pragmatic level (see comments 2, 5 and 7) is currently absent from the definitions, the revision of the glossary is the natural place to anchor it.
public.suggestedRevision: When finalising the glossary, define pragmatic interoperability (shared use of exchanged information for appropriate action) alongside the existing definition of interoperability, and align the conformance chapter's vocabulary with it.
